title: malephora ochracea
intro: Malephora ochracea, commonly known as 'Yellow Crassula', is a succulent plant species native to the southwestern parts of the United States and Mexico. The plant is known for its small, yellowish-green leaves and stems, which are often used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Malephora ochracea include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as wounds, fever, and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects.
